# Provenance and reuse

Original preview source was extracted from the owner's Liberty Framework revision
recorded in docs/migration/extraction.json. No new external mod implementation was
imported during separation. Generated art retains requests, prompt history and hashes.

The shared third-party register and notices remain in
[Liberty Framework](../../GTAIV-Reborn/third_party/README.md). Reuse source/assets only
where the recorded license permits it; preserve notices and per-file provenance.
LVS source adaptation and closed-mod research are different evidence/reuse cases.
